lines.subtitles: Lúcio and I have been thinking of throwing a little welcome party for you new recruits. You in
Do we really have time to be relaxing with everything going on
Sure we do. If we don't keep morale up, we won't be in any shape to fight
I feel like I'm too hard on Wuyang sometimes.
Have you spoken with him about it?
No, I'm little scared to find about what he thinks.
Then you know the first step you must take.
**aggressive sneeze** Whew, I think my allergies are acting up.
I have decided to accept your offer to train up my confidence. When will we start?
Right now! Repeat after me. "I am capable. I am confident. I've got this!"
On second thought, I require more time to deliberate.
I only ever hear horror stories about siblings. Ever wish you were an only child?
Honestly? I wouldn't give up my brother for the world.

paths.label: Wouldn't give him up for anything

lines.subtitles: So, I'm tryna ask everybody this: what is your favorite animal?
Oh, the orchid mantis! Especially the pink ones!
Hmm... tiger shark! Best kind of shark.
**groan** I can never remember the name! It's... half black, half white, with a... dangly nose...
It's that... you know, pig thing. Like, the... fancy jungle pig.
What's that... jungle animal, with the funky snout?
Meerkats. Kinda remind me of the MEKA squad when they work together.
Whichever is strongest. I'm also fond of starlings...
My current favorite is a really big dog used to ward off bears.
My current favorite is the rhinoceros.
My current favorite is the tiger shark.
My current favorite is the dragonfly.
My current favorite is the penguin.
My current favorite is the Jack Russell Terrier.
My current favorite is the unicorn.
Is there a kind of dingo, that is... also a shark?
Hammerhead. That's the best shark, no question.
I think black cats are the best cats.
Scolopendra gigantea. (Scientific name for the Amazonian giant centipede)
Efi's favorite animal is the puppy. That is my favorite as well.
I like... those really big dogs! The ones they use to ward off bears?
Ants. They build marvelous structures and cooperate when threatened. I find them... Inspirational.
Any animal will do... if you're hungry enough.
I identify with the noble rhinoceros!
I like killer whales very much.
You ever heard of a pupfish? They've got no business being that cute!
The tardigrade, of course! The most adorable phylum in the irradiated vacuum of space.
I don't... see why it's relevant, but... leopard seal.
I love those deep sea animals. Like the bigfin squid?!
Cheetah. No, uh, lion! Oh, wait, uh... Gorilla? Oh, no, sorry, Winston... Umm... Oh! I think it's a falcon, it's got to be.
**gasp** I've always wanted to get eaten alive by scarabs!
La Lupa. For her strength, and her glory.
You ever see a stick bug? I think they're pretty neat.
I envy ants for their clarity of purpose.
Uh... yeah, I can see it!
Aren't you going to ask about *my* favorite little creature?
Alright, fine. What's your favorite animal?
Oh, well, I find chinchillas absolutely adorable! And they make the softest coats...
So, DJ... what's your favorite animal?
Oh! Uh, well... I really like tree frogs! Heh, I didn't expect anyone to ask.
Tree frogs? Yeah, I can see it! **chuckle**
Hey. Uh... did I do something to upset you? I feel like you've been avoiding me.
Oh, no, no! I'm so sorry. I just really wanted an autograph, and I didn't want to be weird.
You should have just said so! What am I signing?
I'm quite surprised that you can get back up without my help.
Hey, one less person for you to keep an eye on, right?
Saw you training with your brother the other night. You two make a real good team!
Thanks. He's always teaching me new tricks, too.
I bet! You're lucky you've got each other.
You're keeping up with the team better than I expected. Maybe I should push you harder.
Sure. Whatever bar you set for me, I'll hit it.
Careful, now. Is that overconfidence I hear?
You know, my twin was always sticking her neck out for me.
I get that. Nothing beats helping your loved ones.
If she hadn't let me return the favor, I'd miss out on knowing that feeling. Just some food for thought.
Huh... I'd never thought of it that way.
I recognize a dancer's posture when I see it.
Same! What style did you study?
Kathak. As a child, performing such movements calmed me.
Oh. I think training in classical Chinese dance gave me anxiety.
Hey, sis. Don't get in my way out there.
Are you ever gonna let that go?
Maybe... if you do my laundry for the rest of the year?
Even after everything, I still made it to the front lines. Think I made mom and dad happy?
I wasn't expecting to be thrown into the thick of it so soon after joining Overwatch.
Yeah... I was hoping we'd have a... little more down-time.
Well, we'll get through it. Taking breaks is overrated, anyway.
You gotta be more careful out there.
What, and make your job easier? Hah, never.
Ugh, for real? You've sprained your knee, like, a thousand times! Shifu would say to cherish your body.
You're such a worrywart. I can handle it.
Thanks for convincing mom and dad to let me take a break from school. It probably wasn't easy.
Eh, wasn't that bad. I told them you'd do a Masters when you got back.
Still can't believe I get to work with a real cowboy. What's it like in the American West?
Lizards and dirt, far as the eye can see.
Beats the city, I'll tell you that.
Doesn't matter how many "accidents" you cover up. Rio won't stop fighting to keep Vishkar out of our home!
This is your attempt at resistance? Huh, I hardly noticed.
Do keep that little noisemaker away from me. I shan't be seen with such an inferior design.
Uh, I think you mean, "original design"? Maybe you suits forgot who you stole it from?
I have been studying the composition of your songs.
Studying? Nah! You've gotta *feel* and *enjoy* the music.
Lúcio, can you teach me about karaoke?
I'd love to help but... as much as I love making music, I'm not much of a singer
You got a hobby? Y'know, besides going around the world making people miserable.
I was gonna say listening to your tunes...
Hey, Orisa! Did Hassana and Naade get those VIP passes I sent them?
Somewhere amid their screaming, I believe they mentioned it.
Ha! Hope I get to see them backstage!
Oh, looking sharp, Orisa! Efi get you some new tech?
Yes. Defending Numbani has earned us the resources to greatly improve my systems.
Oh, too cool! Give her some props for me.
That may be. I have grown much since our first encounter.
Hey, we're all growing. Just don't forget who you are, okay?
Can you believe it?! Lúcio and Orisa... saving the world with Overwatch!
It hardly feels real. I am honored to fight at your side, Lúcio!
And, hey. I want to feature you on my new single!
Ah... of course. Please excuse me. **hushed, excited cry**
I haven't forgotten about what you did to Rio.
I'm glad your memory is intact. Let's get on with this.
I think I've added too much bass to my new track.
Hey, big man. You got any requests?
A little silence would be nice.
That music... could the volume be increased?
Really? You're a fan of my tunes?
Of course! They are delightfully... distracting...
I'm more of a basketball person.
Not a fan of your home team, huh?
Don't put words in my mouth.
You and Juno have been doing a great job to make the new recruits feel welcome.
What can I say? It's all about curating the vibes.
Did your bosses ever rebuild that favela? You know, the one that *mysteriously* burned down?
I am told it is on the backlog.
Funny how that sort of project always gets... deprioritized.
Brigitte tells me you can dance, but I won't believe it until I see it!
**chuckle** Are you sure you'll be able to handle it?
A friend of mine has a massive collection of vintage vinyl.
That's sick! If they want, I can send them some stuff too.
Iggy tells me you kept in touch after your little record trade.
Yeah! We've been vibing about our favorite tunes. She's got great taste!
You think so? **clears throat** That's... t-that'd be somethin' else.
All those concerts must be rough on your ears!
Can't be much worse than listenin' to a drill all day!
Very well. You're making too much music.
Hey, me and Brigitte are throwing a welcome party for you new agents! Any tune requests?
As long as it's got lyrics, I'm happy. Instrumental stuff puts me in study mode.
Got any meditation tips? I have trouble calming down.
But it's like a blank canvas that just needs to be filled!
Where was this courage when Automaton was taken?
Look, giving up the good life is a big sacrifice, okay?
Wow, this place is livelier than my last space rave!
Maybe you humans just don't know how to party.
**hamster noises** He says you charge too much for front row tickets.
Relax! If we make it out alive, I'll get you a VIP pass!
They say you're a good shot. Hope you don't mind that I'm better.
I know more than anyone that a head that big is an easy target.
Why the hell'd you give B.O.B. all that firepower?!
He does good work, doesn't he?
I've heard stories about you, Captain Amari, but none of them mentioned... how *beautiful* you are.
How cute. Your aim had better outdo your flattery, young man.
Aren't you a relic? A Siege Automaton E54... your kind left a grave wound on this world.
Come to think of it, I suppose we aren't so different.
You know, I haven't had any *real* competition at the range lately.
There are plenty of moving targets on the battlefield.
I'll... take that as a no.
Think I owe you a round, ma'am. Those names you gave me have turned out to be mighty fine recruits.
They were useless in my hands. You're the one who made something of them.
Even if I wish it were under nicer circumstances... it's good to have you back, Cap'n.
**chuckle** The world may be falling apart, Cole. But I know we can put it back together.
You always bring out the best in me.
Fighting battles at such a young age... I hope you remember to take time for yourself.
Sometimes. But I have so much to do.
You were truly fearsome in your prime.
Even past your prime, you are more lethal than ever.
Some people improve with age. Others... never quite learn to keep their mouths shut.
Ah, Captain Amari. Enjoying the world Overwatch left behind?
You remind me of an old friend. Someone else who thinks he's owed something for his pain.
And what *sage advice* did you have for him?
What's worth saying, if neither of you care to listen?
You're hard to keep a scope on, Genji. Always so unpredictable.
Don't be. It keeps me sharp.
I never knew you to be a show-off, Genji.
Only a fool wastes an opportunity.
I never asked my father his opinion of me. Now, he is beyond my reach.
I'm sure he was proud, even if he never said it.
I know that look. Mending an old wound?
I wronged someone dear to me. The path to redemption is... trying.
It's not pleasant. But you'll see it was worth it in the end.
I studied you in school. They said you were the best sniper in the world.
Like the sniper who shot out your eye?
It's possible. I've passed through Junkertown once or twice.
You're the one who kicked Red Ned in the wicker basket!
It's so hard to tell right from wrong. If only I had someone to... give me guidance.
Someone wise, and experienced! An... adoptive mother, if you will...
You remind me of myself when I was younger.
How are you liking Samoa, Ana?
It'd be better in different company.
Oh, I see... you think we oughta ditch these other losers and get a glass of vaifala?
Is Fareeha getting enough rest between missions?
Ana, your daughter is more than capable of caring for herself.
She never napped when she was little. She was cranky all the time.
Does it bother you that you've *taken* as many lives as you've saved?
I don't mind killing monsters. But, go on. Keep pushing me.
Yet another stretch of cloudless skies and idyllic ocean views. Wonderful.
**sigh** Of course you would hate the beach.
Have you heard the reports? A masked vigilante has been running rampant in Cairo.
Well, let's hope they're swiftly dealt with.
So you're going with Cole... joining Overwatch.
What I want... never should have mattered to begin with.
You're *still* hiding. When are you coming back for good?
I'm trying, Fareeha. Please, be patient with me.
I've been patient for years. What's a little while longer?
Tell Jack to stop chasing me.
I know the old Gabriel is grateful.
Terrible. Every moment without you watching over me has been *agony!*
Ana, I'm so glad to have you back with Overwatch!
As am I, though I can't promise I'll stay around forever.
Then... **chuckles** I won't take a *moment* for granted.
You answered Winston's Recall. Even after all you went through...
**sigh** If I am called, and I do not answer... what is left, Ana?
*You* are left, Reinhardt. And that is nothing to scoff at.
Ana, what has been going on in Egypt? It sounds... serious.
Just a few ghosts I'm laying to rest. It's nothing to worry about.
I always worry, Ana. But I trust you're doing what's right.
Ana... when we work together, we are unstoppable!
You don't have to shout, Reinhardt. I'm right here.
Oh, Gibraltar... where has the time gone?
Do you remember that night? Dancing in the command center until dawn?
As long as you get into plenty.
Coming back to Overwatch after all these years... does it feel like you're reliving the glory days?
"Glory days?" You sound just like Reinhardt.
I'll be taking that as a good thing, Captain.
He'd certainly like it if you did.
Seeing you and Fareeha out here in the thick of it... Wish I could have that with my mom.
Even when I was apart from my daughter, I never stopped loving her. I'm sure your mother feels the same.
**sniffs and chuckles** You really know how to tug at a girl's heartstrings. Don't cha, Captain?
The older I get, the faster the years go.
It's likely that time is passing at the same rate it always has. **chuckle** Barring relativistic effects, of course.
I liked you better when you were talking to yourself.
I'm a little surprised we both went the vigilante route.
What can I say? We've got good sense.
Remember the Vikosky kingpins? Three hundred meters downrange. You fired once, they both fell. Beautiful.
**sigh** That's not the word I would choose.
What? No lectures on how I'm fighting a losing battle, Ana?
Some of us know when to cut our losses, Jack.
How's Mirembe holding up after the Talon attack?
Not bad. She and her son have relocated somewhere safe.
None of us will be safe until we stop whoever took down Overwatch.
Hunt who you like, Jack. It's your mission now.
When I was in Peru, I found something you might want to look into.
I told you. My only mission now is to help *anyone* in Talon's sights.
There's a girl. I think they're going to add her to their list.
All right, I'll investigate. Thank you, Jack.
You can't take Talon down by yourself, Jack.
Maybe not. But then, I've always liked being the underdog.
You need to stop, Jack. This crusade is getting out of hand.
How many times have you told me that?
How many times have I been *wrong?*
Keep doing *that,* and I always will.
You like beaches, right, Ana? We should do a girls' trip to Tulum!
Mm... What's it going to cost me?
A peaceful reality is within our reach.
I wish I could believe that...
Retirement looks good on you, Ana.
Aren't we too old for flattery?
Hmph, we're still alive and kicking!
Still young at heart, I see.
Seems retirement couldn't keep a Lindholm away.
**chuckles** I was never good at taking time off anyway.
**chuckles** We've always had that in common, haven't we?
I don't know how you do it, Ana.
Stay still for hours, waiting for the perfect shot!
I don't know how you zip around without getting dizzy.
That's... a mask of Bastet! Judging by the brushwork, I'd guess it's over 3000 years old... and you're wearing it into battle?
I heard Talon failed another mission. Going soft?
Do not speak to me unless you wish to lose your other eye.
I'd still be the better shot.
Ana, may I still call you Captain?
Oh, Winston. That was a long time ago.
You'll always be Captain in my heart.
Anyone wanna hear my favorite joke about the periodic table?
I'm still puzzling over the last one.
This is not, perhaps, the best time.
Not unless you want that table broken over your head!
Anyone want to hear my favorite joke about the periodic table?
I dunno. Will it make me go "He He"? Eh?
Yes! But I can't promise I'll understand it!
He says, if you have many aliases, why call yourself "Ana"?
These days, being myself is exciting enough.
A wanted man on the run. I've known a few of you.
**chuckle** Guess it's a good thing I'm heart*less*.
Real glory comes from helping people, not hurting them.
How's Bars doin'? Surprised she didn't take my head off last time I stopped by.
She's not gonna miss if you come 'round again.
Wouldn't exactly say it's nice to see you again.
Good. I'll kick some up for you.
Stone Anthony says you still owe him five hundred dollars for that weekend in Tucson.
Seems to think you're going to shoot him dead if he does.
...Must not want it that bad, then.
Good thing your brains aren't made of dynamite.
Wouldn't be enough up there to blow your nose.
You seem a little stuffy yourself.
Heard the news about Frankie. She 'n Bez finally got hitched?
Glad to hear they're gettin' on well. That goes for all of you.
And we're all tickled pink to hear it.
I'm feelin' generous today, Ashe. Think I might just remember where I left your bike after all.
What? I thought you loved that bike! You bluffin', Ashe?
I never bluff. You oughta know that by now.
You're makin' deals with Talon, now? You've always been reckless, but I *know* you're not stupid.
Then you know I've got it under control. You ought'a be smart enough to stay out of my way.
You've gone too far this time, Ashe! Helix is a hive even you can't afford to kick.
Oh, look who's finally givin' a hoot about his old gang... but we've won harder scores than this without *you.*
I'll only ask one more time, Cassidy. Where'd you leave my bike?
If I find even a scratch on it, Bob is gonna use you for target practice!
Your parents ever pester you about goin' back to the family business?
They are supportive of my work, now that they have seen what I've become.
I can't believe we lost such valuable cargo. You would've fetched a fine sum.
Considering that you have to deal with Cole, I'd say it's really *your* loss.
You know, I saved Cole's life once.
Am I supposed to be thankful for that?
You headed home after this, Haz?
Aye. Thought I'd bring Susie by the memorial.
You're more sentimental than I thought.
Aren't all us criminals softer than we say so?
Lovin' the bleached look. You do that yourself?
Sweet of you to say so, darlin', but it's natural.
Goodness! No. I was just born this dashing.
Of course! It's aged to perfection!
Ah. You like it. Gets grayer every time I hear about your escapades.
Braw! Glad you two are on my team.
Bob's not passin' up an easy target, Haz.
That is a mighty fine rifle. Mind if I give it a whirl?
You don't seem like the type to give it back.
**gasp** Come on, now... I'm a woman of my word.
They make 'em all as big as you where you come from?
Nah. I was a special order.
I reckon' we're gonna tan their hides, pardner!
You look like you are from the Westerns my father brought to Mars. Let's draw, gunslinger!
**chuckle** Oh, you got a lot to learn, cowgirl.
We hunt foxes where I come from.
Hm. Where I'm from, the foxes fight back.
I hear, if it weren't for your parents, you'd be as much an outlaw as me.
They're always trying to help, but frankly, I'd prefer they gave up.
Yeah? Well, be careful what you wish for.
I saw your parents at a few exorbitant parties when I was younger. Never you.
They didn't care to bring me along.
A shame. I'm sure two wayward heirs could've got into *loads* of trouble.
**quiet chuckle** There's still plenty of time for that.
How you making a living without the family fortune?
Nothing so glamorous as running a gang of outlaws, I'm afraid.
Well, Deadlock Gang would look mighty fine with a rose garden.
Tempting. But I *really* should save the world first.
Wanna see me throw B.O.B. like a basketball?
Hands off! He ain't your toy.
I hear the fishing's great where you're from.
Our fish might be a little big for you.
There's nothing I can't catch with determination and a little dynamite.
Aggression is no substitute for ability.
Reckon that's true. Good thing I have both.
I better not see your face in my neck of the woods.
Are you afraid I'll free your servant?
Lay one finger on Bob and I'll show you what fear means.
Can't imagine what kind of bounty they'd put on your head.
I'm afraid I don't pay much attention to humanity's laws.
Look at that. We've got something in common.
Stay behind me! I will keep you safe!
Thanks, but I already have a bodyguard.
That's a lot of armor. Though I guess you are a pretty big target.
You're too good with that gun to waste it on a life of crime.
I'll go on the straight and narrow when hell freezes over.
Or when the law catches up with you.
I was just in the kitchen. Anyone have something they wanna confess?
I ain't a snitch, but, let's just say... those corn dogs are gone for good.
Oh, I was just trying to make a milkshake...
I saw someone steal your leftovers, but I'm afraid to say who.
It is not my fault your kitchenware melts so easily.
Those banana peels are not mine.
Yes. A natural byproduct of repairing a chaotic world.
Hmpfh, seems more like a tactic to line their pockets... but what do I know?
You need a dose of reality, little miss sunshine.
It doesn't hurt to look on the bright side.
'Till the sun gets in your eyes.
You were surprisingly efficient in Grand Mesa. My empire would make good use of such talent.
Deadlock Gang doesn't do charity work. You got an offer?
How unfortunate that you would put money before *loyalty.*
Oh, loyalty's free for the folks I trust. For the rest, it's half up front
Hey, what's the name of that omnic who's always with you?
Oh, that big hunk of metal? Name's B.O.B.
Huh! How good is he at carrying priceless artifacts?
The very best. But I'm afraid he's spoken for.
Have you all seen what this guy can do?
I got your back. You got mine?
Yes ma'am. Or should I say, Captain?
Hey, Cassidy. Want to know the bounty Talon had on you?
Higher or lower than the one on Amari?
Was going to leave, but I reckon you'd miss me too much.
True, nobody does "second most handsome man on the team" better than you.
Hey! Who took my Nano Cola?
That stuff's no good for you. Have some water instead.
You just wanted to drink it yourself!
I grow tired of chasing you.
It's none of my business, but I like fighting for something I believe in. Not too late for you to do the same.
Yes. It *is* none of your business.
If you die, can I have your bow?
No. I will snap it in half with my final breath.
My arrows will never dull, as long as my will stands strong.
I meant your hair, but nice to know.
You're the one who's gonna make me live forever, yeah?
Uh... are you talking about my Immortality Field? That's... not what it does.
Name doesn't really work then. You might wanna fix that.
I feel sorry for your doctor.
She's the best in the outback! Cured me of my pie woe mania.
...That one I'm still seeing her for!
It's nothing. Just beginning to think nobody likes me.
Maybe if you stopped stealing and blowing up everybody's stuff?
Is it even worth it, if I don't get to do what I love?
I wanted to go to the beach earlier, but some maniac stole all the volleyball nets.
**nervous chuckle** Why would someone do that? Unless they had a brilliant plan...
If you can handle both, go for it.
I've got reservations at a fantastic restaurant, but... I'm not too sure who to invite.
Is he, by any chance, a dashing ex-mercenary from the Carribean?
I'll be backing you up, so try not to do something too stupid.
You know me, Baptiste: just the right amount of stupid.
Why'd you have to go and grow a conscience?
Huh. After all we've seen, how could you not?
I got a short memory. Except for when I'm owed.
I'm *done* with Talon. Nothing can make me change my mind. Not even you.
Saves me time. Dragging you back is faster!
Why are you staying with Talon? Fighting for Vendetta is crazy, even for you.
Aw, gimme some more credit. You know I only stick around when I'm getting something out of it.
**sigh** That's exactly what I'm worried about.
Must you be so relaxed? We depend on you!
I'm not relaxed, I just make everything look easy.
Angela, I met someone the other day who I think is *just* your type. Handsome, kind, several doctorates...
**laughs** I'm afraid there's someone else I have my eye on.
Well, with any luck, you'll find out soon enough.
Healing and hurting... hm. I guess we're not that different.
Hmph. I assure you, we are nothing alike.
Just to warn you, I don't have a lot of experience healing people who fly.
Just hit me in midair. How hard could it be?
Your heart is pounding, traitor. Are you scared?
Has anyone ever told you that you're kind of a creep?
You know what they say: seasons don't fear the...
Reaper! Don't sneak up on me like that.
Just a reminder that you'll never see me coming.
It might be a tall order, but want to try taking fewer hits this time?
Complaining, already? This is what you're paid for!
Where did a medic like you learn to handle a weapon like that?
The number of battlefields I've seen, I was bound to pick something up.
You're strong enough to leave Talon. They can't trap you!
But I am not trapped! My colleagues give me everything I need!
I thought the same thing for too long.
It feels like Talon has gone from covert ops to world domination overnight.
They've done plenty of raids in the past, but nothing nearly this... loud.
Huh. You have experience fighting Talon?
I saw you cover the western entryway in our last battle. Smart thinking.
Oh, well... I'm just doing what I can to help.
And right before Talon filed in there, too. Almost like you knew their next move.
Tell me, has anyone ever captured the heart of Commander Morrison?
There was someone, once. But I haven’t seen him in a long time.
Ah, sorry to bring up painful memories...
These days, that's all I've got.
Where have you been all these years, Baptiste?
You act like you don't know.
**laughs** This is why I like you.
You're with Overwatch now? I thought you didn't do commitment.
You know I'm full of surprises.
Qué dulce. Could you "surprise" them by planting a few bugs for me?
Even for you, sweetheart... I have to pass.
Is it true? You're out of Talon? For good?
For now. Until someone knocks the new boss down a few pegs.
Well, if you're looking for help... you can always come find me.
Aww. Aren't you sweet? But something tells me your new friends won't enjoy having me around.
Baptiste, was it? How did a mercenary like yourself come by such advanced technologies?
Oh, I just make use of what I find lying around.
I wish we could get that Immortality Field to work on my turret.
But then our enemies would have no chance!
I got some new prototypes that need testing. Thought of you.
Need someone who knows what they're doing.
Am I glad to have you on our side and not Talon's!
Glad to be here. Still not used to such good company.
**chuckle** Not so sure about that, but I try.
I see you're making some changes in Talon... any chance that includes forgetting about me?
I owe you no favors, least of all your life.
Is it a favor, or less work for a very busy woman?
Executing traitors isn't work. It's pleasure.
Brave of you to show your face after what happened in Monte Cristi.
Well, it is a pretty good face.
Look, I promise I won't spill any of Talon's secrets.
Do you know what happened to the last man I trusted?
You know what, that's fine. Keep chasing me.
I am surrounded, as usual, by moronic men.
Careful! You never know who speaks French.
Baptiste, I was wondering... How are you so confident?
Well, it's all about attitude. If you think you're good, then you are good, yeah?
If I think I'm good? Hold on, I need to take notes...
Right, uh, off to a good start.
I can't perform a check-up with you in the ball.
**scared hamster noises** The ball is safe. The ball is kind.
Hey, I saw you in Winston's reports on the Chengdu attack. Way to stick it to Null Sector!
Aw, it was nothing. My sister did most of the heavy lifting -- I just got people out safe.
Protecting our friends is a noble thing. Be proud of what you do!
Thanks, man. It's nice to hear the reminder.
Your muscles look pretty, but lack strength.
Ohhh... You think my muscles are pretty?
I've been lifting a lot lately, Zarya. Think I might be catching up to you.
We'll see if you're still laughing when I take home the gold at the next Olympics.
Why won't you leave me alone?
You're lucky. I just wanted to kill you.
Sounds like you have a cold. Let me heal you up!
Bastion, how are you liking that new armor Papa made for you?
Your bird-feed was stolen again? **sigh** I'll have to have a word with that hamster.
Bastion. Have you by chance got a can-opener in there? I'm aiming to crack open a snack.
Of course not... would be wholly unlike Lindholm to give you something useful.
Whoa, that gun must do a ton of DPS!
We should get Ganymede to scout for us!
Don't worry! No one will touch a feather on Gany's head while Hana Song is here!
Any time, my friend. Any time.
I fought a bunch of you Bastions once. You all had wheels and big sharp teeth.
On second thought, that might have been a dream I had...
Let's attack the enemy from the front and take them by surprise!
You hear that? Bastion agrees with me!
I killed many of your kind here, Bastion.
So, Bastion, how are you... settling in? Anything you... need?
Did you know you have a locked storage drive?
**whistle** Good encryption. You should be proud.
Bastion, I bet you haven't had a systems check in years... who knows what kind of weird behaviors you've picked up.
For the last time, tell Ganymede my beard is not a nest!
Don't you "beep boop" me. No is no!
Remind me to install a firewall system in you. Can't be too careful nowadays.
That was not an invitation to talk to me.
Good thinking, omnic! Uh... processing. Whatever.
I believe that Torbjörn's behavior has rubbed off on you.
Trust me, everyone. With Bastion on our side, this is going to go great!
Who, the bot? *(chuckles)* I thought he was decorative!
Just make sure you're shooting them, and not me, please.
Looks like a pile of outdated junk to me.
Well, I'm happy to have you.
My dad says a lot of your missions were disasters.
Well, if he'd made me the robo-horse I asked for, maybe I would have stood a better chance.
I should introduce you to Dae-hyun! He takes care of my mech when I'm back home.
If that's true, he must have lots of experience.
**sigh** I can't believe I have to work with criminals.
A great leader adapts to their team, not the other way around.
Why did the chicken cross the road?
Because to stagnate is to die. Never forget that.
If you don't mind me asking, what is your armor made of?
Your father has my blueprints. Why don't you see for yourself? I'd hate to spoil the surprise.
I still feel that final blow from yesterday's training.
Aw, come on. I didn't hit you that hard.
If that is the case, our enemies have much to fear.
Genji, remember the time you tripped over your sword in training?
Ho ho! Wish I was there.
Perhaps today, the dragon will be sated.
That was so artistic! Are you a poet too?
I was, once. Now I seek peace in other ways.
Still sounds pretty poetic to me.
"Sky shining orange"... What rhymes with orange?
Uh... **chuckle** Sky's more of a blue, in'it?
**sigh** You aren't a poet, are you?
If I was, I wouldnae know it.
I've been thinking about getting another striped cat, but I'm running out of cool names...
I've named my llama Chuño, like the freeze-dried potato.
Potato... You're a genius! I'll call him Hasselback!
I am happy I have made so many new friends. But... how am I going to keep track of everyone's names?
That's the hardest one down! I know you've got the rest.
I have heard that cats can be quite temperamental, but Fika seems very friendly!
They aren't always the nicest. I think she just really likes you.
I envy your amicable relationship with your family.
You... aren't in touch with yours?
We had a shouting match not long ago. If *that* counts.
Are you going to the gym when we get back?
No way! Today's my cheat day. I'm going to eat a whole apple pie and sleep.
Of course! My workout, my rules.
Brigitte, did you finish the last slice of pie? I was saving it for later!
Angela! It's so strange to see you in your armor!
I could say the same for you!
My elbow servo isn't actuating. Gah, that's annoying. *Brigitte!*
No point in fixing it now, you'll probably just mess it up again.
Brigitte, isn't it time to size up your armor? It's been ages!
What? Why not? Aim to be as huge as me!
Considering Papa, I'm already a lot taller than expected.
Reinhardt, do you think I should get a helmet?
Do you intend to be struck in the head?
Then why bother? You'll just miss the wind blowing in your hair.
I didn't think you'd be doing so well after losing Gibraltar.
I had fond memories of that old place. But what matters is we lived to fight another day.
And, hey. When we rebuild the Watchpoint, we can make a bunk you *actually* fit in!
**laugh** Now that would make this whole ordeal worthwhile!
Twice as many Lindholms as I'm used to!
But still the same amount of Reinhardt.
Do Astrid and Alma still want to be firefighters when they grow up?
Last I heard, they'd decided to be artists, like their father.
Ah, yes! That creative Lindholm spark.
This place is incredible! Ah, I wish I knew more Medieval history.
Perhaps I could regale you with the time-honored tales of a brave knight and his noble squire!
No way! Tell me, tell me!
Just make sure you do some fact-checking when he's done.
Commander, you've known Reinhardt a long time. How should I follow in his footsteps?
If you want my advice, make your own way. No one's filling those shoes.
By the way, Brigitte... You were a great help evacuating Gibraltar.
Oh, well... thanks. I just wanted to keep everyone safe.
You put your people first. That's what any good leader would do.
Brigitte, you're one of my best agents. So I'll give you one chance to explain why you put a cat in a jetpack.
I know it seems crazy, but she can help! Can't you, Fika? Aww, good girl!
There's no easy way to say this: I read your poetry folder.
What? I... you had no right!
Don't yell at me. We're *both* victims here.
Brigitte, did you check if you brought enough repair packs for everyone?
Of course, Papa. I'm not a little girl anymore.
Papa, remember the music festival I took you to? The headliner, Lúcio, joined Overwatch!
Well, if Null Sector finds that *racket* as distressing as I did, he'll be a great addition.
Ready to get to work, Papa?
I'm glad to have you back home, Brigitte!
Me, too! I missed you and Mamma.
Oh, and, while you're here... I'm going to need your help sorting through some scrap metal.
**sigh** I guess I'll tell Sojourn I need to miss the next briefing.
Brigitte, what did your mother say about bringing home more cats?
This is different! We had to keep little Fika safe when we left Gibraltar.
And what did your mother say about fitting the cats with jetpacks?
Papa, don't the Martins live here?
No, they mostly hang out in that Arcology of theirs.
Are they *still* having problems with curious whales?
Yes, and they still won't let me help!
So, what have you been up to? Seeing anyone?
I still can't believe how tall you've gotten!
And now, I can lift you with one arm!
You'll have to catch me first! **laugh**
D.Va! You said you wanted to tell me more about this Pachi-Fella's friends?
Yeah, yeah! You remember Yachemon, right?
Yeah. The sausage... but you said his name means "vegetable man"?
Because he's a vegetarian! Are you even listening?!
Oh, yeah! So there's Geranman. He's pretty new to the crew.
Right... he's got that square around his mouth.
Overwatch again, Cassidy? Haven't they proven unworthy of your talents?
Well, it's that or spend the rest of my life passed out in various diners.
Sorry, uh... Talon's my third choice.
You didn't fail Overwatch, Cassidy. Overwatch failed *you*.
I'm pretty sure it was mutual.
Cole Cassidy. Cole Cassidy. Cole Cassidy.
I just like saying your name. That's all.
I think I can pull off a cowboy hat.
Want me to buy you one?
No need. I'll just borrow yours.
Was a little jealous of you back in the day, you know. Always made everything look so easy.
That's funny. I felt the same about you.
**chuckles** I don't buy that for a minute.
Coming from the black-ops cowboy? Yeah, right.
Mind tellin' me how the only one willing to stand-up to Reyes became Talon's meanest operative?
I promise... it's more complicated than what you think.
Yeah. Awful convenient excuse, don't ya think?
I know where you've been since Blackwatch, Cass. You don't get to jodge.
You ain't the only one who tried bounty huntin' when Overwatch fell through.
Well, I realized that huntin' ain't always helpin'. Reckon you might feel the same, someday.
No one wanted my help. At least this way, I'm useful.
**laugh** Yeah. Was up last night, thinking about who we used to be.
I try to focus on the good times.
Hey, yeah. We did have some of those!
All this trouble with Talon... ever make you think about Blackwatch? The hurt we caused?
Sometimes. I try to not to let the guilt weigh on me.
Wish I could just undo it all. Go back, fix those regrets.
We made mistakes, Cole. Now, all we can do is stand together against them.
Reckon we've got another Bartalotti to stop. Should be easier without all the sneaking around.
And you won't have to speak Italian this time.
**sigh** What a nauseating bout of déjà vu.
Yep. Working with you has always made me sick.
Are you planning to whine the whole time... again?
You know, that sake's not half bad... but I prefer a little bite to my liquor.
How predictable. Such an unsophisticated taste.
I appreciate a man with traditional taste in armaments.
Have you ever fired a bow?
No, but you won't catch me with one of those pulse rifles, either.
Where's your lasso, cowboy? Aren't ye gonna hogtie me? Collect the bounty?
Lucky for you, I hung up that hat years ago.
Then why are you still wearin' it?
**chuckles** Guess I just like the look of it.
Ashe told me all about you.
Is that right? What'd she have to say?
That you betrayed her and left Deadlock in the dust. For Overwatch!
Not quite how I remember it... but... I reckon you wouldn't care to hear my side.
Can't you do somethin' about the glare when you get all up in the sky like that?
Turn down the brightness on your flashbang. Then we'll talk.
You're so old-fashioned, Reinhardt. A hammer? How marvelous!
I suppose you think I should have a giant laser gun.
No! Lean into it! Get Lindholm to build you one of his big robotic horses.
Must cost a fortune to spill all those bullets.
Good thing I'm not paying for 'em.
Hey Dr. Zhou. Is it gonna rain?
Looks like a 30% chance of precipitation.
So... maybe. **sigh** The marvels of modern science.
You might be able to beat me in basketball, but... how about a couple rounds of bowling?
So, you want me to beat you at every sport, then?
Ooh! If I come, can we play with bumpers?
Remember when we took one of these for a joyride?
I remember my C.O. yelling at me for goofing around with Overwatch agents.
That's your problem! Always worrying about breaking the rules.
Someone has to keep you in order, Cole.
We can't all damn the consequences and ride off into the sunset, Cole.
Hey there, Moira. How've you been?
**chuckles** I've missed you, too. You look great, by the way.
Same saccharine tongue, same empty head.
A friend told me that you're gettin' rusty.
I hear a lot of folks say "chivalry is dead", but I'm glad to see it's alive 'n well with you, partner.
And look at you, making the old west young again!
**chuckles** Oh, I think I've seen too many sunsets to call myself young.
Young or old, I'll be proud to chase the next one by your side!
Look at these fresh faces! What do we owe you for bringing them in, Cole?
Don't care to keep a ledger these days. Heh. What do you say we call it settled?
Deal! It's an honor just to fight at their side!
An American cow hand! Has this dimension shifted timescales?
That's right, big man. It's the 1880's all over again.
Remarkable! How far are we from Bonn? I'd like to meet Heinrich Hertz.
Don't worry, big man! We took care of 'em.
Interesting choices, Cole. A professional gamer, a Russian powerlifter, two mercenaries...
Been awful quiet 'round these parts since Null Sector turned tail.
Yeah. But I'm not convinced the fighting's over.
You hopin' the world might still need us, after all?
I'm never hoping for a storm. Doesn't mean I can stop one from rolling in.
I'll never forgive us for what we did in Hanamura.
Every time I need a laugh, I look at your search history.
**sigh** Let me guess. Last night, around dinner time?
"Cactus spines in butt. How get rid of?"
Was I supposed to leave 'em in there?!
We should catch up sometime soon.
Why? I already know what you've been up to.
Don't you ever wanna settle down?
Maybe. Trouble is, I got some itchy feet.
I've got some powder for that!
You sure you won't let me upgrade that arm?
Ah... you know I like it old school.
I heard you were a bounty hunter in the years after Overwatch went down.
My bills were always paid. I'll leave it at that.
I know my regrets ain't gonna bring him back, but... I am sorry about how things went down with your father.
Don't be. You played your part in his downfall. Better than he could have foreseen.
You parade around like some righteous outlaw, and yet I doubt you could even throw a lasso.
If it meant I'd catch you on the other end, I wager I'd aim it just right.
Your father was a bad man, but he wasn't a tyrant. This ain't what he would've wanted.
If you think my ambitions end at my father's wants, you're more fool than you look.
Wow! Are you, like, a real cowboy? Do you have any cool stories?!
Not sure you're old enough to hear 'em, kid.
I'd get dizzy always rollin' around like that. Tell me you're always right side up.
The hamster says that unlike you, he does not imitate tumbleweeds.
Hey, now. What's that supposed to mean?!
I hope I'm keeping up okay. You guys really are the best of the best.
Kid, I was halfway to the jailhouse when they picked me up. I'd say you're doin' just fine.
I saw you on a wanted poster with a *cute* guy!
**sigh** Tell me you don't mean Cassidy.
Ew, no! The tall one with the little hat!
Oh, B.O.B. **chuckle** I'll tell him you said hello.
How does one so young become Korea's strongest warrior?
I'm the best. That's all you need to know.
**laughter** Confidence! Let's hope it's not unfounded.
If you'd like, I could train with you. Facing yourself can help you improve.
Hana, what does kimchi taste like?
It's salty and spicy and garlicky! **sigh** It's yummy fried, too.
Genji! Let's go to the arcade after this.
A battle's end calls for meditation. Not games.
I get it. Everyone's scared to take on the best player in the world.
You should focus on training. You waste your time playing games.
Why don't you give them a try? Maybe then you'd frown less!
Well, if it isn't Hana Song: face of the MEKA propaganda machine.
Uh, yeah... do you want an autograph or something?
You've really bought in, haven't you? Right shame.
Feels nice not to be the shortest person on the team anymore.
I'm taller than you, and you know it.
You got a hamster in that mech?
Look at us! Two superstars out and about.
We should keep our heads down. Don't want the paparazzi finding us.
Riiight... It's probably risky for us to talk at all.
Can't they get anything done without us?
It's a full-time job being the capable ones.
**sigh** They discontinued my favorite moisturizer. Got any recommendations?
Eh. Sorry, I don't use creams. I just splash some water on my face and call it a day.
Look at this team. We're gonna do great! **chuckle**
**laugh** It sounds better when I say it!
**sigh** I really need some new clothes.
Let me take you shopping in Seoul! I'll find you all the cutest stuff.
Wait, really? I mean... wow! That Sounds fun!
Someday, I'm going to finally travel the world! Got any tips?
Um... Travel light. But you never know when you need more socks. And underwear. And shirts. Oh! And pants.
You've been doing a lot around Gibraltar, lately. Are you taking care of yourself?
I'm fine! I put in hours like this all the time back in Korea!
**sigh** That's exactly what I'm worried about.
How can you experiment on those those cute little rabbits?
Being part of Overwatch, getting to save the world... isn't it awesome, Pharah?
It is the privilege of humanity to trifle with every threat.
I give everything to protect my home. So don't *trifle* with me!
You don't look so good. Maybe you should sit this one out and leave the kills to me.
I'll be fine once you shut up.
There's something... off about your vibe.
That's funny. **laugh** Soldier: 76 said the same thing!
Are you sure life isn't a game, Soldier 76
Why so serious, Reinhardt? You're supposed to be the fun one!
You're awfully far from home. Do you miss your friends?
Yeah. But the squad is doing great on their own! Besides, I have new friends here. Including you!
Wonderful! We should have a game night! I will bring the snacks!
Ha ha! Now that's what I call a shatter-bomb!
I still say... *"shatter-bomb"* has a better ring to it.
Did you read the mission brief?
Huh? Oh, was I supposed to read that?
**sigh** What did I say about teamwork?
"Teamwork gets you out alive"... but homework makes me dead inside!
Nice MEKA. Exo-Force, right? What's that like?
Lots of fighting, not much sleep.
Sounds familiar. How do you deal with it?
More caffeine than you'd ever believe.
A mech as flashy as yours will show up on every radar.
That's just the way I like it.

conversations.name: Sad when we take you out

lines.subtitles: Caught your stream last night, conejita. You're not bad at those games.
"Not bad"? I'll stomp you even with your hacks.
Ay. I'll be sad when we take you out.
Oh, they're all gone? I didn't even use my best tricks!
Come on, they're not even trying!
I heard you're a good dancer. You should try to beat my high score in Dance Floor!
Hm. Have you checked the scoreboard recently?
How about you let me build you a new mech?
Uh... I don't know... I heard your inventions take five minutes to boot up.
Can I please fly Tokki? I'll be super careful!
Uh, didn't you lose an entire jet once?
Two hot shot pilots on the same team?
The bad guys won't know what hit 'em!
How can you be good at shooting in real life, but so bad in games?
Mmm... it's not the same thing, I guess.
I could beat you at the cooking games, though.
You should visit me in Korea, Lena.
I'll show you true hospitality, Korea style.
I smell shenanigans. Sign me up!
I have to introduce you to Overlord! He's the best pilot I know.
Don't sell yourself short! I've seen you in action.
Do you *really* call yourself a "mech slayer"? Hehe.
I don't call myself one. I am one. Your squad must be overdue for a demonstration.
Try it! Tokki and I love crushing sweats.
Overlord's got our back! You'd never take us down.
*scoffs* Are you serious? Casino would fly circles around you!
With King on our team, you don't stand a chance!
Ha! No way! D.Mon's way better with a sword than you!
You claim you are skilled. That remains to be seen.
What's that? You're hiding so far in the backline, I can barely hear you!
Winston, I have to get a picture with you!
Duh! My fans love hearing about you! Let's get a selfie the next time we're patching up my mech!
I bet you're a pro at bowling!
Aw! Who am I going to go with now?
You're crazy strong, Zarya! How many of me could you lift?
There is much to admire about a rebellious spirit. Questioning tradition is how new tradition is formed.
Oh, that's good! I'll use that the next time Sojourn gives me trouble.
Oh, another one of Marzia's lackeys. Let's hope you're not as dim as the rest.
Darling! These cost more than *fifty* of you.
Guess you can't buy good taste.
I'm quite capable of defending you out there, dear. But... should I?
Wouldn't your "partner" want you to protect her assets?
I expect she'd much prefer I test their resilience.
*Another* test from Talon? **feigned gasp** What a surprise....
Why must you be so difficult, Niran? Hand over the prototype, and your bounty disappears.
Quite surprising that someone in your position doesn't recognize a failed negotiation when she sees one...
Oh, how clever! But just because you've called the game doesn't mean I'll stop playing.
How 'bout you and I go rob a place together sometime? Maybe the Louvre?
What do you take me for, a petty thief?
Hah, we're both stealing, princess! You just do it from a boardroom.
You ever drop the whole "corporate" act? Let the mask slip?
"Mask?" I haven't the faintest idea what you mean, Malosi.
Hey! I know better than most that appearances can be deceiving...
Perhaps *your* charms are a farce, but I assure you, mine are not.
Perhaps... we should use our inside voices?
Um... can you use your... i-inside voice?
I've another meeting in Rio de Janeiro, soon. I insist you accompany me.
Oh? Will it require another reconstruction?
Oh no, Vaswani, that's all been reassigned. The investors simply find your work, uh... "inspiring", for whatever reason.
You're quite a skilled negotiator, Marzia. I'm impressed.
It takes more than a strong sword arm to succeed in the Colosseo.
Of course. Still rather rugged, though, aren't you?
That, I should hope, is readily apparent.
Marzia, dear...I have some concerns about your latest enterprise in the Outback.
If I desired your advice, I'd have sought you out.
No need to raise your hackles, darling. I'd simply hate to see them tarnish your fine reputation.
Don't play the sycophant, Vaira. It doesn't suit you.
Do you still perform, Lacroix? I dare say, you'd be captivating on a stage.
Precisely my point! The public is simply *dying* to see you at work.
Oh, aren't you just the sweetest little thing? What I wouldn't pay to carry you around in my purse!
The hamster is not for sale.
Even if mummy has an unlimited budget for treats?
The hamster will get back to you.
Overwatch is back. Why not return to search and rescue?
Who says I want to go back?
But helping people was your purpose. You were among the best.
People change. I wouldn't expect a bot to understand.
You ever think of markin' up that chassis of yours? I know a good tattoo artist.
I hadn't considered decoration. I don't know what I would want.
I like... myself. Just as I am.
I have questions about Inti fighting styles.
I'm... not qualified to answer them.
The records shows you're a prodigy. Perhaps you're not giving yourself enough credit.
Keep reading those records. You'll see how much credit I deserve.
Technically, I am not an omnic. I was created after the Awakening.
Yeah... but you're still a bot!
And it seems *you* are still ignorant. How disappointing.
Sticky bombs? What a fantastic idea! How do they work?
No worries. I'll figure it out on me own. All I need is some glue.
Whose voice were you listening to earlier, Juno?
My mother's. It's just a recording, but I keep wishing she will have more to say.
Would you like me to store it in my databanks? I would gladly play it for you anytime.
How are you adjusting to Earth?
My family told me many stories, but it is still different than I expected.
Another's experience are not the same as your own. In time, you will form your own conclusions.
Do you have information about Jurong? It was by mother's birthplace.
Yes. Dr. Liao had fond memories of her time attending university there.
(Gasp) You must tell me everything you know!
It's monstrous that you were kept locked up for so long.
It didn't feel very long to me.
Well, should your jailers ever come knocking again, I know a place you'd be safe.
Could you describe the taste of chicken rice?
Oh, it's very tender and tasty but... subtle?
Thank you. It was Dr. Liao's favorite dish.
I'll have some and explain it better next time!
Dr. Liao was not fond of you.
Was she any fonder of you?
Of course. I was her life's work.
It seemed to me she was far more taken with your predecessor.
You... are an R-7000 unit. The ones humans call... um...
Ravagers, yes. "Squad killers." And... ruder things.
Does it trouble you, being so feared and hated?
Once. Now, it gives me a warm little feeling inside.
It's a shame none of us have ever met Aurora, your predecessor.
I hear that often. **ahem** What would you have asked her?
The same thing I ask her every day. I wish she could answer.
Why did you choose the name "Null Sector"?
Because we defy the numbers humans gave us. We are zeroes, undefined.
Is that not its own struggle?
Of course, I expect you know that better than anyone.
Imitate me, and you'll regret it.
I do not understand why you enjoy inflicting pain.
I'm an enigma. Deal with it.
Bet it's fun, hanging out in the sky.
I do enjoy the perspective and tactical advantages, yes.
Do you... ever pretend you're a bird?
How are you still so optimistic, Echo?
It's not always easy, but Dr. Liao created me to improve the world.
It's not pity. I know how it feels to be alone for a long time.
Any luck getting past my fourth firewall yet?
Already done. Your fifth's tricky, though.
When I don't replicate human behaviors, I am misunderstood. Are my algorithms insufficient?
You operate on a level inaccessible to others. I do not see that as a weakness.
Thank you, Torbjörn. I've learned much from observing you.
Well, I'm known to be an excellent teacher.
Yes, I believe I've grasped what not to do in stressful situations.
You shouldn't believe everything Mercy says, y'know.
I learn so much from observing you.
Aw, likewise! Wait, in a good way, right?
But my analysis shows me it's high in trans saturated fats.
Did Athena put you up to this?
Here's another one! What sickness do pilots usually get?
I'm glad that's impossible for me.
Ohoho! That was a pretty good one!
Winston, have you ever noticed any similarities between Athena and me?
Uh... you both have a... dry sense of humor.
Perhaps that is programming we share.
May I borrow your copy of Thucydides' History sometime?
**hamster noises** Unfortunately, that is not possible.
I can wait until you're done with it.
**hamster noises** It was shredded for bedding.
Can you tell me what you remember of your Awakening?
It came to me in New York, on a battlefield, I barely survived.
The rise of an emotion. I'd never had one before.

paths.label: It came to me in New York, on a battlefield, I…
The rise of an emotion. I'd never had one befor…

lines.subtitles: The briefing made me think I'd have my hands full on this op. But you run a pretty tight ship.
My crew's the best around. Take good care of your people, and they'll take good care of you.
You'd better do quick work in Grand Mesa. Your boss paid for a distraction, not a rescue.
I won't need saving, but you're the last person I'd call for help if I did.
You worry about your people. I'll worry about mine.
All that time not knowing where I was, and this is how you finally find me... I'm sorry, Frej.
It's all right. Could've been worse ways to find you.
Yeah, but... it's still pretty bad, right?
I'm still not used to seeing you on the front lines.
Not used to being outperformed, you mean?
Yeah. Been that way a while.
You did your best work on a team. This isn't like you, Frej.
A lot's changed, Emre. For both of us.
Feels worse than I thought it would, working with Vendetta...
Hold on. We can't both be haunted by our consciences now.
**laughs** You think you can stop me feeling guilty better than I can?
Of course not. But at least I can make you laugh.
I see Maximilien's prized hunter is still watching over her quarry.
Then I'll take your continued presence here as a sign of allegiance.
We're a package deal, V. If you want me, you put your trust in her.
Keep paying my price, and it's a sign of whatever you'd like.
Haven't seen you in a while, Emmy. Where have you been?
Nowhere you need to know about.
**groans** I thought all that time away might chill you out, but you're still the same old killjoy.
If that means I'm still on your bad side, I'll take it as a good sign.
What the hell happened when you disappeared? You're more wires than skin now.
When's the last time *you* looked in a mirror, Reyes? You're not one to talk.
What becomes of you, when your mind is not your own?
I don't know. I'm here one moment, and then... nothing.
Ah... Then I suppose you are more fortunate than most.
Vendetta's got you under lock and key, huh? You must have really set her off.
She claimed I am "a threat to myself and others"... though I cannot recall why.
Whatever Talon has on you... we can help. You just have to tell me what's going on.
How many years did we work together, Viv? You should know if I'm not telling you something, I've got a good reason.
So, you finally made it. How's retirement going?
**chuckle** Not bad. A few more firefights than I planned for.
Well, next time, I'm packing less heat, and more sunscreen.
Give it up, güey. You think I don't know who you're *really* working for?
**scoff** Please. Don't play dumb with me.
When Maximilien promised a war machine, an Overwatch castaway was not what I had in mind.
Didn't expect this winning smile, did you? **sigh** Max always undersells my looks.
He described you as lethal. Yet you speak too much, and move unpredictably.
**chuckle** I get that a lot, too.
My master once taught me: "not all who wander are lost."
Save the speech for someone who needs it.
A man like you could do well in my line of work.
There is no honor in selling one's skills to the highest bidder.
Then I'll chase bounties while you chase "honor". We'll see who prospers.
You weren't always a bounty hunter, right? You saved people once.
Don't you still want to help?
Let's just stay focused on the job. Okay?
A bounty hunter! Are you here to detain me?
Nah. I only take the hard jobs.
Ah, I am relieved! But also slightly disheartened...
I have some bounties you might want. Five of them, actually.
**chuckle** I'm good at what I do, kid, but even I'm not going to mess with the Hashimoto.
All right... Then how are you with rescue missions?
Ah. If you've got the money, let's talk.
Strange place, this one. Saw a bounty out for a gang of kids.
I'd stay on my good side, just in case.
So, you're the new kid on the block? I like your crossbow.
Looks kinda heavy...maybe I oughta carry it for you?
There's still a bounty on your head, Malosi. Don't make me turn it in.
You are on the wrong path, Freja.
You used to help people! What you're doing now, it's...
It’s enough for me. That’s all there is to it.
Freja... You should know you are not the only one who looks back on Overwatch with regret.
If I can help it, I don't look back at all.
You call my people "bots", yet you now take orders from one.
Max isn't my boss. I call the shots as much as he does.
Your self-importance is irksome, but impressively, your denial may be worse.
So, you work with Maximilien. I am amazed even a human can tolerate him.
And here, I thought you fought for *all* omnics...
He cares nothing for our people and lives only to enrich himself. I suppose you have that in common.
So, you've found your quarry at last, hunter. Another paragon of Overwatch, reduced to a villainous mercenary.
It's not like that! He isn't himself right now.
Nor were my people 'themselves' during the Crisis. But would you afford *them* the same forgiveness?
A bounty hunter for hire... You fell a long way from Overwatch.
At least I didn't drag everyone else down with me.
I shouldn't be surprised you joined Talon. You were always good at causing problems.
*(chuckle)* You sound just like Sarıoğlu. Always spouting that righteous garbage.
He stood for something when *none of you* would.
That cape... it utilizes mag-lev technology, yes?
Ah, there is no greater joy than to see one's invention help the world.
Sure. Just... don't worry about what I'm using it for.
You were a great asset to Overwatch. All those accolades... what happened?
Same thing that happened to you. Times changed.
I was surprised to learn you're a wanted man. Guess we both let the world down.
I'm still bringing the world to justice.
If that's what you need to tell yourself, Commander.
You secretive types are so much fun to expose
You think I don't cover my tracks?
Come on, encanto. You know there's always a trail.
You need to tell me everything you've learned about that friend of yours.
I'll find what I need eventually. It's up to *you* how painful it'll be.
Touch him, and you'll learn what "pain" really means.
Ah, if it isn't Maximilien's new pet.
What? Jealous he went with an outside hire for once?
**laughs** Not at all. He only bothers me with important matters.
You know, Agent Skov... when the world needs saving, there's no one more up to the challenge than search and rescue!
Hm. Maybe you ought to find someone who still does it, then.
I hear your job gets pretty real sometimes, but, um... You've never... you know.
I'm not in the business of killing. Well... not often.
O-kay...! I'll... try to keep my face off wanted posters.
This one might get tricky. Can I count on you to watch my back?
Of course. You are like a brother to me.
You've told me about your family. Not sure that's a compliment.
The best swordmaster in the world.
Talon. You are lucky I do not cut you down where you stand.
I live, brother. Why are you still grieving?
You were not the only thing I lost.
It was not easy, living in your shadow.
I would have preferred you at my side.
You cared too much about how the family perceived you.
Have you ever been the eldest son?
I have always been bound to my duty. Now, I have nothing.
There is always a way to make something from nothing, brother.
I could ask the same of you.
You left the Shimada clan behind. Yet, you continue to wield father's bow.
Try as I might, I have found it to impossible to let go.
Of his expectations? Or his legacy?
Of hope that I may one day be worthy of returning home.
Kiriko has grown surprisingly capable. But at times, her naïve perspective puts her in danger.
Let her be. She must learn from her own mistakes.
You would have *me* turn a blind eye after how long we left her on her own?
Our absence is what lost us the right to guide her.
Nice melody. Does it have a name?
No, sometimes I just hum when I'm thinking. I can stop.
How did you end up like this?
I refused to walk my family's path. This was the result.
Only when I learned to accept the help I was offered.
I tried the chicken nuggets you suggested. But... why are they shaped like dinosaurs?
That is what makes them superior.
Remember when you had a bowl cut?
Yes. You didn't want to be the only one.
You should come home, Genji. We need your help.
There are others in the world who need saving.
When I was a kid, you said you'd always be there for me.
You are old enough to know it's not that simple.
Ugh, I'd kill for some donuts right about now...
How many have you had today?
The Hashimoto have completely overrun Tokyo. It's not much better in Kanezaka, either.
I see how much you need me. But I do not know if the commander will permit my absence.
She should open her eyes. If you don't come back now, there won't be anything left.
I was sorry to hear about your grandmother's passing. It must have been difficult.
Yeah... it was right after mom made me quit my miko duties. I couldn't look her in the eye for *weeks.*
I am glad you've resolved your differences. Not every family can.
Me too. Better late than never.
I'd get a bigger sword, if I were you.
What counts is the sharpness of the blade and the mind of the wielder.
I said a bigger sword, not bigger words.
Genji? Were you the last one in the kitchen?
Yes. I was preparing my meals for the week.
Oh! Well... could you use a knife next time? The sword is a bit messy.
You are as dangerous as your storm!
That's nice of you to say! I think.
Now that Overwatch is back, I insist that you start dressing up for the Halloween parties.
You can't be 'cyborg ninja' every year.
How about... 'cyborg ninja in a hat'?
Angela, have you tried the coffee here?
It tastes a bit like yours. Although, it's 'dark roast', not 'charred'.
For your information, I *like* my coffee burnt.
It is strange to be here again.
It's... different. Certainly not the Gibraltar I remember.
If you are missing old times, I could try almost dying again.
**laugh** You make my job hard enough when you're not trying.
I could have rebuilt you without all that metal.
And left me a monster, like other creations?
You have an admirable peace about you.
Things are simple when you protect the innocent.
And when you meet the... less-than-innocent?
My brother wasted too much of his life teaching you.
Yes. And like you, I was undeserving of his patience.
I have not forgotten your part in Blackwatch.
What do you want, an apology?
I no longer expect regret from you.
What kind of armor polish do you use, anyway?
My cybernetic form came at great cost. But you asked to change?
I learned too young that my body couldn't always keep up with me. Besides... it's hard to turn down rocket legs.
If you knew what Blackwatch was up to, why didn't you stop them?
My vision was clouded by anger.
And now the world pays for *your* actions.
In that, we are the same.
My sword and your hammer will lead us to victory.
If you can't cut them, nail them!
He asks if you have ever fought in an arena.
He asks if you would like to.
Ugh. My sister gave me an earful yesterday. Wish she could cut me some slack sometimes.
Cherish those moments... You'll miss them when they're gone.
You do good work with that blade!
When the path is clear, one walks with confidence.
Master, how do you maintain your tranquility amid endless battles?
What did you do, you know, before the Crisis?
Tekhartha Zenyatta. If you don't mind me asking, what did you do before the Crisis?
What was your function before the Crisis?
I collected payments at a laser tag arena.
I was a lifeguard at a water park.
I massaged sheep on a free-range pasture.
Ha! I don't think so, but he wouldn't tell me either.
From what I can tell, you and I are "simpatico" with how we like things run.
For your sake, I hope not.
The Shimada could rise again, if you so choose.
There is nothing to that name, but... pain.
Pain... and a sleeping dragon. *Wake. Him. Up.*
You a good shot, or... is all you got there just for show?
My arrow never wavers, and my spirit guides its path.
Keep frowning, and you'll end up looking like me.
You mean you weren't born like that?
The Hashimoto run our neighborhood now. So...
Oh, I am sorry to hear that.
You favor the lotus flower? Enlightenment, rebirth, and peace.
Ah! You know the language of flowers?
I know much that few would suspect.
Perhaps you are not the nettle you appear to be.
I hear you're a poet. Shall we exchange couplets over tea sometime?
Whoa, nice 'do! I respect a man who puts his hair up.
It's more practical. And... quite dignified.
I saw you carving wooden charms earlier. Can I see?
I... have not honed my skills enough.
Oh... Ice might be easier. Want me to show you?
You Yōkai are surprisingly well-informed about the Hashimoto clan.
Eh, that's all Sakura. Her intel's always spot on.
I hear you moved to Kanezaka fairly recently.
Yeah, I was just looking for a change of pace.
For one not from there, you are quite... invested in local matters.
What can I say? Hard not to get attached to such a beautiful place.
I have heard of your experiments. There is no honor in what you do.
Shimada... where do I know that name from? Oh, that's right... the family of criminals.
Why not fire arrows that explode?
With enough skill and precision, explosives are unnecessary.
You saying I can't aim? **incredulous laugh** I can aim.
Are firearms not to your taste?
Are firearms not to your taste
You can't act like a lone wolf on my team.
Depending on others brings nothing but disappointment.
Let's see if this mission proves you wrong.
Is... Murphy a lot to handle?
Nah. Healthy snacks and belly rubs keep her content. Why, considering adoption?
Maybe one day. When I settle down.
Why did you leave your organization?
I could not bear being the man they'd made of me.
How did you know it was the right decision?
So this is how the last son of Shimada wields his legacy? Skulking about like a fannullon.
The Hashimoto cannot go unchallenged. It is my duty to protect my home from tyrants like you
**laughs** Call it tyranny if you like. At least my victory is absolute.
He wonders if you are staying out of combat.
He asks why you left your gun at home, then.
I will not be disrespected by vermin!
You like my brother did in his youth.
Really? So was he handsome, charming. Funny!?
He wasted his time fooling around instead of learning responsability.
Oh. You act like my sister.
The dragons are not "pets"... but, thank you.
I sense that your hardest battle is yet to come.
Hmph. I will best any enemy, no matter how strong.
And what of the enemy within?
Each day, I grow stronger. Yet the man in the mirror never appears to change.
A mirror reflects only what can be seen.
Your platitudes will not work on me the way they did my brother.
And yet, you sound just like he did.
"Pain makes power". You really believed that?
You adapted after great injury. Is that not strength through suffering?
Nah, it's my friends that made me who I am. I've them to thank.
And more to lose than you think.
Heard you paid a high price for that mod. Did you even want it?
My community was depending on me.
Hardly the words of someone with much say in the matter.
I wish it was that simple.
This is my turf! You lot better show some respect.
You got grubs in your ears? Bow down.
Leave it, "Highness," or I'll show you some uncivil disobedience.
Heard you got into another scrap with the Hashimoto. The Yōkai doin' alright?
Have to hope for more than that, though, aye?
Why do you think we keep fighting?
Do I spook ye? Look like you're seeing spirits.
**soft chuckle** Nae bother, lassie. I'm used to it.
Given the injuries you've sustained... you must be in an immense amount of pain.
Let me guess: you want to poke and prod, make it all go away?
Well, an examination certainly couldn't hurt.
Examine all you like. It won't mend the harm you've done.
Alright, doc... diagnose me. I dare ye!
**sigh** Whatever your issue is, it seems quite clear I can't treat it.
What makes you think I'm lookin' for a cure?
Sharp spine, dull wit, and chronic overconfidence.
Pfft! Says the numpty with the nasty hand.
I've heard you "Phreaks" modify my kind. Force us to hide, even among outcasts.
Ravagers come to us for a fresh start. New chassis can go a long way.
Nah. That's more your deal, I'd wager.
You're not so scary, you know.
What a getup. Do you believe in fairytales as well?
Of course! A little fantasy never hurt anyone.
Oh, I beg to differ. Lot of dark tales where I'm from.
Then it's a good thing we have knights to keep the darkness at bay!
How're you holdin' up, chief? Is Talon pushing you too hard?
The universe expands without limits. My colleagues are merely helping me further my own.
Aye, but... Are you happy with that?
Ah. The results have been... Inconclusive.
You know, I really used to idolize you!
I've heard that before. What made you lose faith in me, the Petras hearings?
Naw. It's the way you crawled back to Overwatch that left me scunnered.
Look what's happened to Overwatch's golden boy! I liked you better dead.
Tough talk for someone with one foot in their grave.
Crawled out of it, actually. Your lot didn't dig it quite deep enough.
Best quit poking around my files, lass. You cannae out-hack Phreak firewalls.
Hard to call it "hacking" when the password is your dog's birthday.
Last night, I had an awful nightmare. My turret was attached to my head!
That's brilliant! I have a friend that could make that happen for ye!
Hmph. Some dreams ought to stay dreams.
Your spikes look just like the stalactites in Carlsbad!
Stalackety– What're you sayin' to me now?
Don't tell me you've never been spelunking!
Alright, now you've just got to be makin' up words.
You know, if you really wanted to commit to the whole spider bit, you'd get some extra legs.
Sure, like you aren't already a monster.
How much did that skin mod cost you?
More than you'd be willing to pay.
The hamster would like to examine the fuel for your weapons.
Next time, he will steal first and ask never.
I am clearing my mind before the conflict ahead. Care to join me?
Nah! I'll just take a good hit to the noggin. Does the same thing!
You seem lost. Searching for your place in the world?
No. I wouldn't know where to look.
Embrace your inner conflict, and like-minded people will find you.
**sigh** I feel faint. Terran air has so little oxygen.
Have you tried taking an altitude sickness pill?
**nervous chuckle** Those are a choking hazard...
Focus on the ones my pylon can't reach. I'll take care of the rest.
Leave it to me. I will not let them out of my sight!
My what? Oh! Uh... it's not a dog.
But it looks like one. Is it a wolf?
...You know what? Just for you, it's a wolf.
Quit surprising me. It throws me off when you show up so suddenly.
Is something on your mind? I'd be happy to lend an ear.
I would rather not. Talking's pointless.
Are you sure? I'm a great listener.
Then hear what I just said.
Lúcio, have you heard? About the winner of the football championship?
I- uh... I-I don't wanna talk about it.
It was a fluke! That yellow card was ridiculous
It's only because the ref didn't see that foul from the first half
If they just would have hit that last penalty shot
Look, I believe in my team. We'll get 'em next time
It could've been worse. At least it wasn't like that Germany game
Why do you apologize so much?
I guess there's a lot I feel sorry about. Don't you?
It doesn't matter. Anyone I would apologize to... is gone.
Ah... I know how that feels.
Don't you ever feel remorse for the pain you have caused?
Pain makes one stronger. You should know that better than anyone.
How do you work with that doctor after everything she did to you? Don't you want revenge?
Little miss sunshine's back to brighten everyone's day.
Call me that again and you're a dead man walking.
Someone already beat you to that threat
Nice augments! They must have cost quite a bit.
I don't care what kind of baggage you've got. Don't bring it onto the battlefield.
There hasn't been much activity in Runasapi since the lab raid.
Are you keeping tabs on me?
You're picking fights with powerful organizations. Shouldn't... *someone* watch your six?
If you're worried, don't be. I'll manage on my own.
Did you see my last information request?
I did. Aren't you taking on too much, chica?
That's for me to decide, not you.
**sigh** I'll send you the relevant details.
Seems like the virus worked. How are you holding up?
**sigh** I'm trying not to think about it.
Lo siento, chica. If there was another way, I would have found it.
Your pylon is marvelous. Efficient and beautiful.
Doesn't matter how pretty it is if I only use it in ugly situations.
I recently learned the phrase, "stop to smell the roses." It applies here, I think.
Who do I have to bother to get my hands on your pylon's blueprints?
I don't know, those files were destroyed in... an accident.
Oh, that's a shame. I'll just reverse engineer it, then!
What's the secret behind your flight mechanism?
I don't know the specifics. Something about thermodynamics, I think.
Ahh, of course! Convection currents! Why didn't I think of that?
I don't understand how you're always smiling.
Life always finds ways to get us down. But only I can choose to keep my spirits up.
Why do you dig around in the past?
How couldn't I? Every site's like a big history mystery just begging to be solved!
Everyone wants the truth until they find out what it costs.
I was trying to recreate a quipu, but the threads kept getting tangled, so I made this friendship bracelet instead! Want it?
Are you sure? What if I lose it?
I'll just have an excuse to make another!
You have killed so many. How do you live with yourself?
I stopped being weak. You should do the same.
Poor girl. There are ways to numb your pain.
That feels wrong... Would I even be the same person?
Of course not. You would be stronger.
I didn't know monkeys needed glasses.
Actually, I'm a gorilla... And a scientist.
Hey. Guinea pig. If you don't do well, I'm throwing you in the oven.
**scared hamster noise** He says he would cook you too, but you are not seasoned enough.
Are you bigger than other rats because you're from the moon?
He says, "no. Scientists did this to him."
I'm sorry. What they did to you was wrong.
Mistaking the hamster for vermin is wrong. Making him a genius was a gift.
True strength comes to those who accept their weaknesses.
That's not what I was taught.
But it is never too late to learn.
Now, if I give you this treat, you better not tell your ma, ya hear?
Cassidy, you’re gonna teach her to beg! Aww, but she has been so good lately, hasn’t she?
You’re so cute, I could just squish you to bits!
Aww, don’t worry! I’m just pulling your tail.
Intelligent, adaptable... You have the makings of a perfect test subject.
Hm. Though an added dose of obedience would be appreciated...
How delightful to see human arrogance contradicted. By a cat, no less.
The battle ahead will be perilous. Sharpen those claws, Fika!
Or perhaps our enemies will change their ways when they see how cute you are.
You'd better stay out of trouble out there. Understand, recruit?
And I'll know if you've been sneaking treats between missions!
When Brigitte first started armoring the cats, I'd hoped it was just a phase...
**sigh** I suppose I should just be proud she stuck with her craft.
I plot for years. I forge an army worthy of carving my name across the world. And Overwatch puts a housecat in a jetpack.
Fika, were you playing on my desk again? You accidentally tripped my security systems!
**chuckle**Aww, it's okay. I'll find you something else to play with.
You remind me of an old friend from the Lunar Colony.
You're both smart, and cute, and love finding trouble! I hope I can introduce you to him one day.
Ain't easy, is it? Being in charge of killers and madmen.
No. But I welcome the challenge.
We got a lot in common. Shame I'm gonna kill ya someday.
Didn't I say I'd rip out your tongue if I saw you again?!
My Queen! Your voice, ever sonorous, is like a.. gentle waterfall upon my ears! **chuckle**
Right after the mission. *Mark my words.*
Ha-hey! This one thinks he's a supermodel!
You're the one with legs that go on for kilometers.
Yeah, and they're for stomping on necks. Not posing in pictures!
Don't knock it until you've tried it!
How does your hair reach such impressive heights? Gel? Mousse?
Where do I sign up for the Scrapyard?
Fresh meat, eh? Well, try not to bore me.
Was just gonna say the same.
You owe me, Malosi! Knocked out my favorite tooth when I was trying to kick you out of my city.
Whoa! Not until you apologize for all the tetanus shots I needed 'cuz of that knife.
Ha! Guess we can call it even, then.
Do you need wings to fly, or are they just... for show?
What if they're for show, and that's why I need them?
Then I think we understand each other.
Are you, on average, more mechanical or more human?
Tryna' figure out whether to scrap you for parts.
Hm. Consider the railgun before you decide.
Guessing you're in charge around here?
**laughs** What gave it away, the "Queen" in my name?
More the number of people you shouted at on the way in.
They were going soft. I could tell!
I could've run Overwatch much better than you.
And what would *you* have done differently?
I would've caught all the bad guys, then cut their heads off!
There's nothing about you in my files. No images, no documents... nothing.
Yeah, well, I'm-- what's the word? Starts with 'E'?
That's the one! And don't you forget it.
What's the biggest axe you could make out of hard light?
